entries.note: Only attached snapshot/output bytes from the selected retained PTY feed libvterm. Sequence gaps request a fresh snapshot instead of replaying a launch command. The terminal emulator supplies key/control encoding and screen state; it is not a plain output log. Scrollback, selection, cursor properties and complete CLI/font/resize behavior remain separate qualification work.

Only an attached snapshot explicitly waitingForView needs the presented message. Ordinary terminals and older services receive no new readiness traffic. Attachment sequence recovery resets local presentation state but never spawns or resumes a CLI; the retained service releases each handoff gate once.
